chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The woman in nifās refrains for the number of days that she used to refrain during menstruation, and she observes an additional precaution of two days.
And the hadith of Zurārah, as narrated by al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd from Ḥammād from Ḥarīz from Zurārah from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, has already preceded in explained form.

key_terms.أَيَّامَهَا: the number of days applicable to her case
key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation; here, her established menstrual period used as a measure
key_terms.بِيَوْمَيْنِ: by two days; an added precautionary duration
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she observes additional precaution beyond the usual period
key_terms.مَشْرُوحًا: explained in detail or elaborated previously

ai.seo_question: How long does a woman in nifās refrain according to this hadith from Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning nifās, stating that a woman in postnatal bleeding remains excused from ritual acts for the number of days corresponding to her usual menstrual period, with an added precaution of two days. It also points back to an earlier, more detailed narration on the same issue, indicating cross-reference within the hadith corpus.
